run_szbuild_pexe_translation: run szbuild.py to translate a finalized pexe into a native executable using Subzero and llc
build_hybrid_symbol_linking: build a hybrid translation with per-symbol Subzero or llc selection via include/exclude regex patterns
test_link_sandbox: test LinkSandbox to link objects into a sandboxed PNaCl executable for x8632, x8664, or arm32
review_match_symbol: review MatchSymbol to determine whether a symbol name matches include or exclude regex rules
create_build_regex: create BuildRegex to generate a combined regex string from symbol name ranges and literal patterns
